name: termux-boot
description: Runs Nix-on-Droid boot scripts at device boot. Foreign-signed BOOT_COMPLETED receiver that reaches the host app over its dangerous-level RUN_COMMAND permission, because a shared uid is impossible without the host's signing key.
_doc_membership: Constellation membership is DATA, not a directory-name convention: data/regen.sh admits any repo whose build.json declares android.application_id + release.ghcr (or forks / lib_apks). This repo is named for the host it targets rather than ac_cloud-*, and joins the fleet on the strength of this file alone.

android._doc_application_id: cld.termux.nix.boot, NOT com.diegonmarcos.*: the manifest namespaces every intent action and permission by the host package, so this id tracks the host's. RENAMED 2026-08-31, com.termux.nix.boot -> cld.termux.nix.boot (18 chars either way, matching the same-length discipline of the host rename), to pair with the renamed Cloud Terminal (Nix) = cld.termux.nix. Orphaning the old RUN_COMMAND grant is now the POINT, not a cost: the grantee package com.termux.nix no longer exists, so the grant it was recorded against is already dead and the old boot APK addresses nothing. Only the installed applicationId moves — the gradle namespace and the com.termux.nix.boot Java package stay put (compile-time only), as does RUN_COMMAND_SERVICE, which is the host's CLASS name and was untouched by the host's applicationId rename.
android._doc_host_package: Compiled into BuildConfig and substituted into the manifest as ${NOD_PACKAGE_NAME}. Must match the installed Nix-on-Droid package or every intent this app sends is addressed to nothing. Was a gradle property with a default buried in app/build.gradle. Moved to cld.termux.nix on 2026-08-31 to follow ac_cloud-nix-on-droid's 2026-08-30 rename: until this line changed, the app kept BUILDING AND PUBLISHING GREEN while doing nothing at boot, because setClassName/RUN_COMMAND/the uses-permission/the queries entry/the /data/data/<host>/files paths all derive from here and all pointed at a package that had ceased to exist.
android._doc_target_sdk: 28 on purpose. Raising it puts the BOOT_COMPLETED receiver under Android 10+ background-start limits, which is exactly the thing this app exists to do.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR + sops-decrypts the passwords. NO fallback. Note this key is NOT the host app's key - see AndroidManifest.xml on why no sharedUserId is possible.

release._doc_kind: 'lib' = a companion APK that ships behaviour rather than UI. Its only activity is a one-screen status page; the product is a boot receiver. data/regen.sh files it under the SuperApp Constellation page's Libs tab.
